role: parameter-free definable subset of a model
notes: The set of x in the universe of a model of T satisfying a formula theta in F_1(T); Vaught writes {x/|=_A theta[x]}. No parameters. Overlaps the global term-substitution use of theta only by letter; scoped to this section.

role: source notation for an arbitrary infinite and an arbitrary uncountable power
notes: Vaught's notation for powers in the hypotheses of 5.1 and in the remarks on Los's conjecture.

role: new unary relation symbol naming an elementary submodel
notes: Vaught's singulary predicate in the proof of 5.4; local to the auxiliary theory.

role: relativization of the quantifiers of a formula to V
notes: Atomic formulas unchanged; existential and universal quantifiers bounded by V.

role: auxiliary theory in L plus V
notes: Sentences of T together with the source's displays (1) and (2); depends on theta.

role: the two relative interpretations of T in T'
notes: Vaught's <v_0=v_0,R v_0 v_1 v_2> and <V v_0,R v_0 v_1 v_2>, for an arbitrary relational/constant language.

role: L-structure on the V-part of a model of T'
notes: Equals I_V applied to the model.

role: chosen proper elementary extensions in the chain constructions
notes: Annex-only notation: E^+ a prime proper extension (5.3), S^* a saturated proper extension with the same theta-set (5.4); Vaught's A^*.

role: field of elements of K algebraic over the prime field
notes: For K = C this is the field of complex algebraic numbers.
Complete theory of infinite sets; complete theory of (omega_1; omega).

role: set of sentences not assumed complete
notes: Local to the lemma recording Vaught's note 17 (categoricity without finite models gives completeness); distinct from the standing complete T.
Vaught's notation (p. 315): T_1 the theory of infinite discrete orders with a first and no last element; T_2 the theory of real closed fields.

role: order types (reverse of omega; type of the rationals)
notes: Source notation in omega+(omega^*+omega).eta (p. 315). eta overlaps the global term-substitution eta only by letter; scoped to this subsection.

role: complete theory of the real field
notes: Language {0,1,+,-,.}; local to the lemma on one-types.

role: integer numeral term; formula expressing v_0 <= m/k in the real field
notes: Annex-only notation in the proof of the one-type count.

role: complete one-type of a real number over the empty set
notes: Annex-only; the set of one-variable formulas true of x in the real field.
